Founded by Josh and Zach, Drone Animal Rescue uses cutting-edge thermal drone technology to help locate and reunite missing animals with their families when time matters most.

Watch trusted Drone Animal Rescue pilots use advanced thermal imaging drones to locate animals that are nearly impossible to detect from the ground, bringing real-world rescue missions to life.

Through our interactive rescue map, we connect lost pet owners with experienced, vetted thermal Drone Animal Rescue pilots, creating a trusted network that responds quickly during time-critical searches.

Follow along as we share real rescue stories, behind-the-scenes footage, and field updates from active searches in real time.

Real Rescues. Real Technology. Real Heroes.

THIS is Drone Animal Rescue.🐾🚁
